quarantine.reviewed: Original email opened. Choose every destination yourself before filing.

quarantine.file-error: Could not manually file this email.

link.title: Link status
link.local-note: This shows what this device last recorded about the client's secure link. A change made on another device may not show here.

active.title: This client link is active
active.body: The client or household can still use the secure checklist link.
active.action: Copy it again if the client needs it.

expires-soon.title: This client link is close to its end date
expires-soon.body: The link is still usable, but it is near the date saved on this request.
expires-soon.action: Extend it if the household still needs to send items.

expired.title: This client link has expired
expired.body: The saved end date has passed, so the household needs more time or a fresh link.

revoked.title: This client link is turned off
revoked.body: The old link no longer accepts client submissions.
revoked.action: Regenerate the link when the household should send more items.

new-device.title: A new device was seen for this client link
new-device.body: The app noticed a different device label for this request.
new-device.action: Review the received items before accepting them.

duplicate.title: A duplicate submission was received
duplicate.body: The app saw the same submission marker more than once.
duplicate.action: Review the client items and keep only the version you want.

integrity-mismatch.title: A received package needs checking
integrity-mismatch.body: The app could not safely match one received package to this client request.
integrity-mismatch.action: Do not accept that package until the client sends it again.

routing-failed.title: One received item needs routing
routing-failed.body: The app could not place one received item into the client checklist.
routing-failed.action: Review the intake inbox and route the item by hand.

extraction-failed.title: This document was saved, but could not be read automatically
extraction-failed.body: The document is safely filed. You can review it yourself or try reading it again.
extraction-failed.action: Try reading the document again when you are ready.

shared-intake-setup-required.title: This device needs shared intake setup
shared-intake-setup-required.body: A teammate's device received a client response but does not yet have this request's checklist.
shared-intake-setup-required.action: Finish shared intake setup before filing this response.

regenerate-available.title: You can make a fresh link
regenerate-available.body: A fresh secure link can be made for this household without losing items already received.
regenerate-available.action: Regenerate the link if the household should continue.

empty.title: No active onboarding requests
empty.body: Start a new client to send their secure checklist.

modal.stale-error: The missing items changed. Regenerate the draft before saving.
